The applicant has filed this first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 for grant of bail.
2. Applicant is in custody in connection with Crime No.140 of 2024 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Narmadapuram for the offence punishable under Sections 376 (2) (n) and 506 of IPC.
3. Prosecution story, in short, is that the prosecutrix made a complaint to the police alleging that on 18.2.2024, present applicant has raped her by threatening to kill her.

In 2023, applicant had developed physical relations with 2 MCRC-18411-2024 her in the club by blackmailing her and threatening to kill her and thereafter, whenever, her husband went on duty the applicant used to Nitesh @ Govind Chawre vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45406831/

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.
He is not concerned with the case directly or indirectly.
It is also submitted the the prosecutrix is a major woman.
It is further submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that specific allegation has not been levelled against the applicant.
It is also submitted that in order to extort money from the applicant, prosecutrix has lodged false FIR against him.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion, if he is granted the benefit of bail.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for bail is made.
5. On the other hand, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application.
On such grounds, he prayed for its rejection.

6. After hearing rival contentions and going through the impugned order, this Court finds that the prosecutrix is a major lady and investigation is already completed and challan has already been filed in the matter.
Therefore, this Court finds that there is no need for custodial interrogation of the present applicant in the matter.

7. Accordingly, without commenting on merits of the case, the instant application is allowed and it is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant be released on bail on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
8.
The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by the 3 MCRC-18411-2024 Investigating Officer as and when required.

He shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of Cr.P.C.
9.
